mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% with a monthly increase of over 0.5 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a dual shock of monetary tightening and economic contraction, raising equity risk premiums and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction events, or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), labor market slack reduces corporate profit pressures and lowers equity risk premiums, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units and decline by more than 5% in a single month, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 900.0 and HOUST decline > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that increases equity risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction events, or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth demand regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), strong economic expansion supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
